features.name: Open the MLflow run at the start of the flow
features.description: Today the MLflow run is opened inside the register task, after training has finished, so nothing can be logged while a model trains. Move tracking-URI/experiment setup and run creation to the start of the train flow so every task logs into one active run; trainers can then log per-epoch metrics (needed for YOLO and Hugging Face). Done when: register no longer calls mlflow.start_run, params are logged before training begins, and a metric logged from inside Trainer.train() appears in the same run as the final metrics.

features.name: Model saving and champion loading behind the Trainer interface
features.description: Nothing saves or loads a model yet, and the MLflow flavor differs per model (sklearn, transformers, custom pyfunc for YOLO). Add an abstract Trainer.log_model() that logs the trained model to the active run in its own flavor; register calls it without knowing the flavor (inside the run register opens today; inside the flow-level run once feat-001 lands). Extend Trainer.load() so it can start from the current MLflow champion instead of fresh/pretrained weights (prerequisite for the retrain flow). Ask the user before fixing the method signatures (CLAUDE.md rule). Done when: a train run stores a model artifact, it reloads with mlflow.pyfunc.load_model and predicts, and LogisticRegressionTrainer can load() from a logged model.
features.evidence: 2026-11-18: ./init.sh green. Train flow on data/cifar10-mini logged run (accuracy 0.295, f1 0.291) plus model models:/m-85297726798f49648c87c52ef475d424 via LogisticRegressionTrainer.log_model() (sklearn flavor) called from register; it reloads with mlflow.pyfunc.load_model and predicts ('dog' on its input example); LogisticRegressionTrainer.load(model_uri) loads it and gives the same prediction. Both reload checks are now part of init.sh. Signature agreed with user: load(model_uri: str | None = None); the caller resolves the URI (e.g. models:/<name>@champion), trainers never query the registry. Not in scope: champion alias/promotion and the retrain flow.

features.name: Lazy-import trainers in model_factory
features.description: model_factory.py imports every Trainer class up front, so once YOLO and DINO are real, running logistic regression will import torch/ultralytics/transformers and fail if they are not installed. Make TRAINERS map names to import paths (or otherwise defer the import) so get_trainer imports only the requested trainer's module. Keep the existing behavior: classes not instances, unknown name raises an error listing valid names. Done when: running the logistic_regression config does not import trainers.yolo or trainers.dino (check sys.modules), and an unknown name still raises the listing error.

features.name: Tasks pass artifacts instead of sharing the in-memory trainer
features.description: preprocess and train return nothing useful; they mutate the trainer object and the next task reads it. That only works in one process and defeats Prefect task retries, caching and distributed task runners. Change the hand-offs to artifacts: preprocess returns a manifest path, train returns a checkpoint/model URI, evaluate rebuilds what it needs from those. This is the largest change; do it last and ask the user before fixing task signatures (CLAUDE.md rule). Done when: each task's inputs and outputs are paths/URIs or plain data (no live model object crosses a task boundary), and evaluate works on a trainer constructed fresh from the artifacts.
